title: Composition interactions and layout
description: Standard-owned declarative blocks for composition documents (MapPackage/AppPackage): `interactions` wires component events to bounded action verbs; `layout` places widgets on a grid. Bindings are data, never code: the only dynamic element is $event.* path substitution in string argument values. Actions never emit events (only user gestures do), so binding graphs cannot cycle by construction. Reference resolution and the per-(ref,event) fan-out cap (recommended 8) are validation-gate responsibilities. See docs/adr/0030-declarative-interactions-and-layout.md.

componentRef.description: Reference to a component declared in the same composition document: `map`, `layer:{id}`, `widget:{id}`, or `control:{id}`. Must resolve within the document (validation-gate check, not a schema check).

eventName.description: Closed event set: featureSelect/featureHover (layer sources), selection (widget sources), change (control sources), viewportChange (map source). Extending the set requires a standard ADR (ADR-0030).

actionVerb.description: Closed verb set drawn from the existing composition vocabulary. Verbs mutate presentation/exploration state only, never source records (ADR-0028 unaffected). Extending the set requires a standard ADR (ADR-0030).

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the document's interactions block. bind_interaction replaces an existing interaction with the same id.

on.description: The user-gesture event source. Implementations MUST bound the number of interactions sharing the same (ref, event) pair; a cap of 8 is RECOMMENDED, and documents over the cap are rejected, not truncated.

args.description: Static JSON arguments for the verb. A string value beginning with `$event.` is replaced at dispatch time by the value at that path in the event payload (e.g. $event.featureId, $event.value, $event.bbox). No expression language: no arithmetic, no conditionals, no function calls.

do.description: The action. Verb-driven state changes MUST NOT re-enter the interaction dispatcher (actions never emit events).

disabled.description: Authored-but-inactive binding; retained in the document, skipped at dispatch.

x.description: Grid column of the item's left edge (0-based).

y.description: Grid row of the item's top edge (0-based).

layoutItem.description: Grid placement for one widget (or the map). The ref must resolve within the document — same validation gate as interactions.

interactions.description: Declarative event→action bindings between components of this composition document.

columns.description: Number of grid columns; 12 is the default.

grid.description: Grid geometry. Rows grow as needed; only columns are declared.

items.description: Widget placements. A composition with widgets and no layout is valid; hosts choose a default flow.

layout.description: Presentation-only grid placement for the document's widgets.
